messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The figure stands in profile, then turns its body and head to face away from the camera, raises its arms to its chest, and finally turns back to the original profile stance.","camera":"Static, eye-level, full-body side view.","clothing":"A white long-sleeved shirt under a dark gray vest, maroon trousers, and black shoes.","hair_color":"Purple.","hairstyle":"Short, cropped hair covering the top of the head.","identity":"A slim, 3D-rendered humanoid figure with a smooth, featureless face and dark skin tone.","scene":"An outdoor paved area, like a parking lot, with a metal guardrail, trees, and a rocky hillside in the background under bright daylight."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a futuristic urban area with a large metal structure to the reference outdoor parking lot with guardrail, trees, and rocky hillside. The character remains in a similar full-body side view and performs the same turning and arm-raising motion, but the hair appears purple instead of reddish, the vest appears darker gray, and the trousers appear maroon rather than orange-red.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the source scene with the reference parking-lot environment while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, camera framing, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the character’s facial expression was preserved, since the face is small and not clearly visible
unexpected_changes: Hair color changed from reddish to purple
Outfit colors changed, with a darker vest and maroon trousers instead of orange-red pants
Lighting and color grading became warmer and more naturalistic
